supersedes.note: All 0.1.0-draft checks, evidence rules, blocker vocabulary and raw-evidence formats are unchanged. 0.2.0-draft adds the frozen per-class expected-answer-geometry metadata and the mechanical calibration representativeness sanity layer (ceiling geometry floor + upper-geometry example coherence). Retained 0.1.0-draft setup documents from older frozen snapshots stay structurally valid evidence under their own snapshot; they are never relabeled and are not grandfathered into new campaigns.

purpose: Frozen pre-scoring setup (preregistration) for scored WELP campaigns — plus a bounded mechanical sanity layer that catches obviously under-representative calibration BEFORE scored work. First motivated by the lfm2.5-8b-a1b hardening-validation campaign, where two toy retrieval calibration examples legitimately passed the ladder yet froze a 512-token ceiling that truncated both scored context-recall tasks: the judgment-layer representativeness review alone missed the mismatch until scored truncation exposed it. The sanity layer predicts no model response length; it fails setup closed only when the frozen declared answer geometry of a class contradicts the selected ceiling or the calibration evidence.
scope_note: This is WELP preregistration evidence, not a competing LLMGauge schema and not an orchestration recipe. It carries no model outputs and selects no winners; it only proves the experiment was fixed, evidenced and reviewed before scoring.

interface.check_setup: check_setup(root: Path, setup: dict) -> list[str]; [] = the frozen plan may gate scoring; entries are plain blocker strings
interface.synthetic_builder: _synthetic_setup(root) -> dict — selftest/integration helper; writes a complete valid evidence tree under root/evidence/setup/ and returns a guaranteed-valid document for the same root
interface.validator_integration: Verify the manifest pointer (setup_evidence {path, sha256}) first, json.loads the document, then call check_setup(evidence_root, doc); root is the directory the document's evidence paths resolve against

versioning.rule: 0.1.0-draft documents validate under the 0.1.0 rules only (no geometry requirements). New campaigns under snapshots from welp-next-snapshot-2026-09-24-review-and-setup-hardening onward must freeze 0.2.0-draft documents.

expected_answer_geometry.min_tokens: integer >= 1 — the frozen declared minimum expected VISIBLE answer size for scored tasks of this class, derived from the fixture rubrics (how much answer structure the rubric can evaluate)
expected_answer_geometry.max_tokens: integer >= min_tokens — the frozen declared maximum expected answer structure for the class
expected_answer_geometry.basis: non-empty string stating the fixture/rubric derivation of the declaration — a frozen human declaration, never a computed complexity score and never fake precision

task_class_keys.reasoning_bearing: explicit boolean — whether the class expects reasoning-bearing responses. Reasoning consumption NEVER fails calibration: all sanity floors read the visible answer only, and no check fails a class for completion_tokens being large
task_class_keys.upper_geometry_example_id: non-empty string naming one preregistered calibration example of the same class that represents the upper expected response geometry, or explicit null when the class declares no distinct upper geometry; missing key is a blocker

sanity_checks.ceiling_geometry_floor: the qualifying/selected ceiling must reach geometry.max_tokens + class maximum answer budget. Catches a ceiling that cannot hold the declared answer structure of the scored tasks (the lfm2.5 defect mode). A genuinely concise class declares a small geometry and keeps its small ceiling — no universal inflation
sanity_checks.upper_geometry_coherence: at the selected ceiling the declared upper-geometry calibration example must have completed with a visible answer of at least min_tokens x MIN_CHARS_PER_TOKEN characters (frozen MIN_CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 2, deliberately conservative — it can only catch gross under-representation, never measure length precisely). When the mechanical evidence contradicts the representativeness review, check_setup fails closed with an explicit error naming the contradiction — the setup does not silently choose between them
sanity_checks.metadata_presence: missing or malformed geometry metadata, a missing reasoning_bearing flag, or an upper_geometry_example_id that is neither null nor a preregistered example of the same class is a blocker

regression_contract: tiny calibration examples falsely representing a long-answer class fail the upper-geometry sanity floor
same-class representative examples selecting a sufficient ceiling are accepted
calibration examples overlapping scored tasks are rejected (unchanged 0.1.0 rule)
missing class geometry metadata is rejected
a ceiling below the frozen geometry floor (declared max structure + answer budget) is rejected
a genuinely concise class is not forced to an unnecessarily large ceiling
a reasoning-bearing class never fails calibration because reasoning consumed budget
non_goals: no prediction of exact model response lengths
no opaque complexity score and no fake precision — the conversion constant is frozen, conservative and documented
no inference, orchestration or network access in check_setup
no universal ceiling inflation: floors come only from the class's own frozen declarations
historical_compatibility: Retained 0.1.0-draft setup documents (including the lfm2.5-8b-a1b hardening-validation campaign) remain valid evidence under their frozen snapshot. Whether such a campaign's calibration would also pass the 0.2.0 sanity layer is evaluated per section 28 of its successor adjudication, not silently grandfathered.
